name: Futanari Sorority
source: Carl is a young student who has chosen to live in a futanari sorority. He was aware that the fraternities request a monthly payment for staying in the house, but the presidents of the sorority didn’t want his money. Rather they wanted a different sort of payment...
translation: 卡尔是一名年轻学生，选择住进一所扶她姐妹会。他知道兄弟会会要求住户每月缴费，但姐妹会会长不想要他的钱。她们想要的是另一种形式的报酬……
